run_evaluate_separation: run the evaluate function to compute SISNRi, PESQ, and STOI metrics for a trained source separation model
calculate_SISNR: calculate the Scale-Invariant Source-to-Noise Ratio between a reference signal and an output signal
calculate_PESQ: calculate the Perceptual Evaluation of Speech Quality score for audio signals at a given sample rate
calculate_STOI: calculate the Short-Time Objective Intelligibility score for audio signals at a given sample rate
calculate_SISNRi: calculate the SI-SNR improvement by comparing estimated sources against reference sources and the mixture
